verdict.rationale: Ollama ships a desktop chat app and launches coding agents, so an AI-assisted document workspace is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents an integrated workspace where an agent drafts and edits documents with automatic saving. Agent launching (ollama launch) and VS Code Chat integration are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
